benchmark.expected_landscape: four mutated positions, near-exhaustive combinatorial GB1 binding landscape
benchmark.name: GB1_Wu_2016_ProteinGym

blind_partition.visible: WT + variants with exactly 1 or 2 substitutions

candidate_generation.allowed_alleles: states observed at each position in visible single/double variants only
candidate_generation.enumeration: all 3- and 4-substitution combinations constructible from visible alleles

frozen_arms.B0_RANDOM: deterministic hash ordering; no outcome signal
frozen_arms.B1_SINGLE_MEMORY: WT + sum of visible single-mutation effects
frozen_arms.B2_CLASSICAL_PAIRWISE: B1 + exact visible double-mutant epistatic residuals
frozen_arms.B3_RELATIVE_RESONANCE: B1 + sum(pair_residual * mutual_relative_resonance). For a pair residual e(i,j), each mutation assigns an empirical percentile of e(i,j) within its own visible partner-residual distribution; mutual resonance is sqrt(percentile_i * percentile_j). No amino-acid property table or tuned threshold.
frozen_arms.B4_DREAM_WARM_ONLY: same score as B3; candidate is WARM iff its mean signed resonance contribution > 0; only WARM candidates eligible
frozen_arms.B5_FULL_DREAM_DORMANT: same score as B3; WARM candidates rank first by score; non-positive support candidates are retained as DORMANT and ranked after WARM, preserving candidate-space coverage

primary_metrics: hidden pooled Spearman over generated candidates that exist in the measured landscape
best hidden-fitness percentile among top-10 predictions
mean hidden-fitness percentile among top-10 predictions
top-100 enrichment for hidden top-1-percent variants
normalized regret of top-1 selected candidate versus best measured hidden candidate

representation.identity: exact parent protein + exact mutated positions and residue states
representation.qualifier: residue state at each mutated position

success_rule.engineering_design_pass: B3/B5 must outperform B1 on pooled hidden ranking and at least 3 of 4 top-design metrics; must not be materially worse than B2 on more than one primary metric; shuffle control must collapse relative to the real-label Lightning result.
success_rule.strong_shareable_result: B3/B5 must outperform BOTH B1 and B2 on pooled ranking and at least 3 of 4 top-design metrics, with top-100 enrichment > 1.0 and shuffle collapse. No retuning after reveal.
